world: World: Ember Leaf Frontier, a burning border forest where a ninja war never ended; dark warm earth, embers, fallen orange and red autumn leaves, ash; warm smoky colours.
ground: a dark forest floor of warm brown earth covered with small fallen orange, red and brown autumn leaves, twigs, a little ash and tiny glowing ember specks.
low: a scorched sunken gully: grey-black ash and charcoal, burnt curled leaves, small charred twigs and a few tiny smouldering orange ember specks; darker than the forest floor.
high: a sunlit ridge: dry golden-orange leaf litter over lighter tan earth with small dry grass tufts; brighter and warmer than the ground below.
trail: a trampled pale dusty dirt road: light tan-grey packed earth with fine gravel, small pebbles and faint footprints, only a very few small leaves; clearly lighter and plainer than a leafy forest floor.
cliff: a low earthen bank: a lip of leaf litter and short roots along the top edge; below it, dark reddish earth and rock with charred roots and thin glowing ember cracks.
